subject: Consolidating marketplace interop: dependency list + workback
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita@cloudlynx.io>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: dustin@cloudlynx.io, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership intro — CloudLynx marketplace listing / integration asks

Hi Irene — thanks again for the intro last week. We've done a quick pass with our PM and infra team and put together a short list of what we think we need from Redwood to make the CloudLynx marketplace listing work and enable the ISV connector (high level):

- API access patterns: account-level creds vs per-tenant API keys; auth flows and token rotation cadence
- Entitlement/contract metadata: what fields we can surface in the marketplace listing and how billing will be reconciled
- Sandbox/test accounts: a predictable staging endpoint with sample data and token TTLs
- Deployment options: which Redwood model variants you expect to expose in the marketplace and any pinned-version constraints

Attached: cloudlynx_api_specs_v1.pdf with our current schema and sample integration flows.

Can we get a short internal workback so our PMs can align timelines? We are targeting the CloudLynx Q4 catalogue push (internal deadline: 2027-10-01) so ideally a Redwood delivery window in Aug-Sep.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m sync if helpful.

— Anita Shah
Head of Integrations | CloudLynx
Anita Shah <anita@cloudlynx.io>

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: anita@cloudlynx.io
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership intro — CloudLynx marketplace listing / integration asks

Hi Anita — great summary, thanks for the PDF.

High level response and owners below so we have a single source of truth while we scope: 

- Auth & keys: Ben (integration eng) will own the auth pattern recommendation and provide implementation notes for account-level vs per-tenant keys. He'll propose a secure rotation approach compatible with our Dedicated and Private customers. (owner: ben_carter)
- Entitlements & billing: Camila (product) will pull the entitlement schema that maps to marketplace metadata and flag any fields that require contract/legal approval. Camila will also coordinate with finance for reconciliation touchpoints. (owner: camila_reyes)
- Sandbox & staging: I will coordinate a sandbox endpoint and test account provisioning details with infra — we'll include token TTLs and example fixtures. (owner: irene_choi)
- Model variants & pinning: Markus (partnerships) will confirm which model bundles we are comfortable exposing at GA and any restrictions for pinned versions. (owner: markus_klein)

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben/ Camila/ I to review the attached API spec and produce a mutual action plan (MAP) spreadsheet with milestones and owners by Fri 06/25.
2) Quick 30m sync w/ CloudLynx on Mon 06/28 to align on timeline and blocking decisions.
3) If MAP requires product changes beyond metadata surface (e.g., new entitlement fields), Camila will open a short RFC and tag outreach to Contracts.

I've attached a starter sheet (redwood-marketplace-mvp-workback.xlsx) — please add any rows on your side and flag items you expect to be >2 weeks.

If this sounds good, I'll kick off the MAP and book the 30m slot.

Thanks — I can host the sync.

Best,

Irene Choi
Partner Product Manager | Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: anita@cloudlynx.io, dustin@cloudlynx.io, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Partnership intro — CloudLynx marketplace listing / integration asks

Irene / Camila — quick tech notes after an initial review of cloudlynx_api_specs_v1.pdf: 

- Auth: our preference is account-level API keys for marketplace listings (simpler for billing and entitlements mapping) but we will provide a per-tenant option for customers that require strict separation. Rotation: we'll support a rotation window where new keys are issued and old keys remain valid for 72 hours to allow rolling updates.
- Models & pinning: we need to clarify whether CloudLynx requires pinned model hashes in the listing. If yes, pinned hashes block our automatic model rollouts and we need an explicit exemption for model patches under security hotfixes.
- Billing metadata: the spec needs a field for 'invoice_reference' to tie marketplace charges to Redwood billing lines; Camila, can you confirm if finance can accept a freeform string or if we need an enum?
- Sandbox: we can provision a sandbox cluster (shared) with quotas. Note that shared sandboxes won't emulate full latency profiles — if you need strict perf parity we should plan a dedicated staging node (cost implications).

I'll take the auth + sandbox implementation story and draft the technical acceptance criteria in the MAP. I'll add rows for: API key lifecycle, token rotation, sandbox quotas, pinned-version exception policy, and an 'integration smoke test' checklist.

Attaching a short checklist to the MAP tab.

— Ben Carter
Integration Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Anita Shah <anita@cloudlynx.io>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: dustin@cloudlynx.io, camila_reyes@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating marketplace interop: dependency list + workback

Thanks everyone — this is super helpful and aligns with where we are internally. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Account-level API keys are preferred for the initial listing. We'll accept per-tenant keys as an advanced option for customers who request it.
- For pinned model hashes: CloudLynx can accept an 'opt-in pinned' listing, but we'd like to avoid blocking your security/patch process. An exemption policy (as Ben suggested) is fine.
- Sandbox: Shared sandbox OK to start; we will scope a dedicated staging environment if perf tests show a delta.

Action items agreed: 
- Redwood to deliver MAP with technical ACs and a proposed Aug-Sep delivery window by 06/25.
- CloudLynx to review and add any compliance/evidence asks (SOC2 artifacts, retention SLAs) to the MAP by 07/02.
- Book 30m sync for Mon 06/28 — Anita/ Dustin/ Irene/ Ben/ Camila/ Markus.

I'll add SOC2 & retention asks to the MAP (we'll upload supporting docs to the shared Drive link) and route any procurement questions to our Sourcing lead.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get this live.

Best,

Anita Shah
Head of Integrations | CloudLynx
